cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've pulled those little plants out so briskly that I've cleared my whole row. What a good start to our vegetable garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those were weeds. You've pulled up the tomatoes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, tomatoes need space. Look how much room we've made for the next ones!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We haven't got any more seedlings. Those were the last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better—we can choose from the whole seed catalogue now. Bring it over; we can plan the entire bed together instead of squeezing round those few plants.
